faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the District Court Ernakulam Driver recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Driver post in District Court Ernakulam is 10th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Driver post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Driver position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,280/-.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Driver position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Driver post is 62 years. There are no specific minimum age requirements mentioned.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Driver role?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for the Driver post is as per the norms set by the Public Service Commission (PSC).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted offline. You must download the application form, fill it correctly, and send it along with required documents to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Driver post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Driver post in the District Court Ernakulam.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Driver role?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their submitted documents.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the District Court Ernakulam.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the District Court Ernakulam located?
faq.answer: The District Court Ernakulam is located in Ernakulam, Kerala, with the pincode 682011.
